name: Pod shell (foam-board box, XPS LE filler, printed nose lip and antenna tube B)
process: knife/laser-cut foam board, hot-wire XPS, FDM lip and tube
notes: floor (front edge notched 4 x 54 mm for the forward-stop T, D-69), 2 side walls (16 x 12 mm power/DShot exits, CR-F2-03; bracket flanges bonded inside), nose wall at x -0.140 (D-62; pitot, vent and antenna holes), aft wall (vent + servo-lead exits), aft deck; the forward stop sits on a 1 mm epoxy line on the nose wall; 6 mm microballoon fillets floor-to-wall at the straps (CR-C6-17); light tape on the top (CR-E3-03) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Tray: bay floor (2 pieces) + forward-stop T + 3 mm aft stop + 1.5 mm guides, FC, avionics and ribbed PDB plates, JR tie bar (printed PETG)
process: FDM PETG, 7 prints epoxied full-area to the floor
notes: R6 (D-62, D-69): forward-stop T (face x -0.1312; upright past the floor edge to a 12 x 54 x 1.2 mm flange bonded under the floor, CR-C3-15), aft stop face x 0.0475 with 2 root ribs on the rear piece (backed by the POD-007 strut); 4 strap slots 26 x 1.8 mm at x -0.079 / 0.006 (D-74); 10 mm wire channel across the bay at x -0.0245 (CR-F2-03); FC on 4 gel cubes between end stops with strap slots (CR-F3-12, CR-C6-19); airspeed between tie posts 21 mm apart, foam tape + 1 tie; PDB plate x -0.038-0.050 with 4 bosses 7.2 mm for M3 heat-set inserts (F1 power frame, 25 mm pattern, CR-C6-27) and a 1.6 x 4 mm rib along each boss row; no UBEC plate (D-74: the zone x 0.044-0.074 holds the right XT30U pair); JR tie bar x 0.021-0.040 right channel (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Hatch (foam board, printed tongue, 12 x 40 hook-and-loop tab, antenna tube A)
process: knife-cut foam board, FDM tongue and tube
notes: tool-free, no magnets: tongue under the nose lip, hook-and-loop tab on the aft deck; receiver antenna A up the tube (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Pack straps (2, 20 mm hook-and-loop, rubber-backed) + 2 EVA pads 2.5 mm
vendor_or_file: battery strap 20 x 300 mm (any RC vendor); EVA sheet 2.5 mm with anti-slip face
notes: two straps at the pack quarter points, overlap >= 50 mm marked; slots let them follow the station range (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: GPS mast with 45 deg pad (printed PETG, plugs into the handle grip)
notes: GPS taped on the pad tilted 45 deg toward the nose, arrow forward; GPS cable up the mast bore; PA66 M3 screw + nut (no steel within 50 mm, CR-C6-18) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Pitot boom socket with 32 mm flange (printed PETG, pod nose, left channel)
notes: bore 6.2 mm for the 6 mm keyed boom (F3 accepted); flange bonded to the nose wall inside face (CR-C6-09) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Carry handle on the spar with the foot bridge, aft-stop strut and wall brackets (printed PETG) + 'LIFT HERE - do not lift by the motors' label
process: FDM PETG, printed lying flat, 40 % infill feet and grip
notes: feet saddle the spar top in the open slot, one 7.6 mm nylon tie each round foot + spar; bridge between the feet (x 0.077-0.090) on the slot fill; R6 (D-69): aft-stop strut (40 x 14 x 1.5 mm pad on the stop back face, three 3 x 14 mm ribs 25 mm long to the bridge, CR-C3-14) and one wall bracket per side (2 mm web from the foot to a 1.2 mm flange epoxied to the side wall over 1 232 mm2, CR-C3-16); legs through the aft deck; GPS cable in the right leg (window at z 0.055-0.065) and a groove under the grip (CR-F2-03) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Trim spacer set: PETG U-spacers 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 8 mm, colour-coded (white / yellow / green / blue)
process: FDM PETG, one colour per thickness
notes: behind the pack, on the aft stop (x 0.0475); set 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 mm (white / yellow / green / blue), every 2 mm stack 0-20 mm; A1 frame-estimate stations (D-62): 546 g 16 mm (-0.036), 550 g 14 mm (-0.034), 590 g 8 mm (-0.028), final from A3 (CR-A3-27); the stack is written on the pack label. CAD and mass: blue 8 + yellow 4 mm (pack at the -0.032 datum); the rest are field kit (ground) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Crush block (XPS F-250, hot-wired, cut per pack, vent groove)
notes: ahead of the pack on the forward stop (CR-C5-02; C5 minimum 25.7 mm for the 550 g class): length = pack fore face - 1.5 mm - (-0.1312): 546 g 26.2 mm, 550 g 28.2 mm, 590 g 34.2 mm (30.2 mm in the CAD at the datum); labelled per pack; replace after any nose-in landing (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Spreader (1.5 mm PETG plate, full block section)
notes: between the crush block and the pack fore face; spreads the pack face load over the block section (C5) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)
